name: Arcane Circle
description: Creates a circle of power where you stand for 20s, 7 tiles across at it's widest.  You and friendlies standing within 3 tiles of it gain 5% final spell damage each second, up to 25%.  The circle stays even if you die or leave.

name: Arcane Destruction 1
description: Rapid detonation at chosen location, striking everything within 2 tiles of it.  The damage is non-elemental.  It can be resisted.  Each cast burns 4% of your maximum mana and part of the damage comes from the mana burnt.

name: Blink
description: Teleports you anywhere within your sight up to 7 tiles away, so long as no walls block the path.

name: Focal Ruin 1
description: Place a point of ruin, causing a wave to go out 3 tiles from that location instantly, then repeats every 1.5s.  Each wave drains 15% of your maximum mana.  Moving, attacking or casting anything else will break the spell.  Will also end if you can't afford the next wave.

name: Grand Arcane Circle
description: Creates a circle of power where you stand for 20s, 9 tiles across at it's widest.  You and friendlies standing within 3 tiles of it gain 5% final spell damage each second, up to 35%.  The circle stays even if you die or leave.  Pure Only.

name: Mana Ward 1
description: Plant a ward on the ground that feeds mana to you and your group for 20% of your maximum mana.  For 12s it gives everyone friendly within 3 tiles, 6% of their own maximum mana each second (Even through walls).  Stops if you die or leave the map.

name: Overcharge
description: For 20s your maximum mana raises by 25%, and everything that draws on it strikes for more.  When it ends, any mana above your normal maximum is lost.  Pure Only.

name: Sciath Anama
description: A permanent ward that when your health reaches 15%, every point of damage will begin to take away from your mana instead.  When your mana can no longer keep up, you'll start to take damage to your health again.  Damage over time is not covered.  Costs 5% of your maximum mana to cast, and casting again will drop the ward.

name: Wild Destruction 1
description: Select a tile and a storm will spawn in a 4x4 block for 8s, striking one random tile in that black about 3 times a second.  The strikes cannot be resisted.  The damage is non-elemental, and scales with your mana.  Ends if you die or leave the map.
